newsitem.title: USA: Texas power prices hold steady on mild weather.
newsitem.headline: Texas power prices hold steady on mild weather.

text.p: Spot electricity prices in the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) held ground Friday on mild temperatures and thin demand, brokers and marketers said.
On-peak firm ERCOT power for weekend and Monday delivery was talked steady in the $17.80-18.80 range, the brokers and marketers said.
Off-peak firm next-day power was again offered as low as $10.00 and $11.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) with few buyers.
Power for the remainder of October with delivery on business days was said to be talked near $18.75 per MWh.
November ERCOT power was talked steady at $18.00-19.00.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
